Every visit is marked as human, bot or suspicious: self-identified crawlers and link previews (e.g. Googlebot, WeChat / Telegram previews) are bots; visits with no language info, repeated visits from the same IP in a short time, or several bot traits together (missing browser headers, HTTP/1.1, old versions like iOS 13) are suspicious. Visits from data-center IPs such as Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS are suspicious with any bot trait, while those with complete browser traits are humans via proxy. Admin stats and reports count only humans by default, and every visit shows the reason. This is an inference from network traits, so scripts running through residential proxies may still pass as human; the result only affects stats, never redirects.
